input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-commitment language. Fees are payable only "as set out in the Fee Schedule" for the licensed Software and Authorized Locations actually taken (§ 11, § 2), and maintenance runs on a "renewable one-year term" (§ 10) rather than a multi-year committed spend. Sparkling also has an at-will exit on 90 days' notice under § 17(b), and the license continues only "as long as fees are paid", so there is no locked-in spend. The § 3 restrictions are ordinary IP/scope-of-use limits, not volume caps or purchase obligations. This meets the preferred position (usage/ordered services only); no redline required. Note only that the Fee Schedule (Schedule "A") is not included in the reviewed text and should be checked to confirm it contains no minimum quantities or non-refundable multi-year prepayments.
